headline: Microsoft's Auto SR upscaling tech launches for Xbox Ally and Copilot PCs
summary: Microsoft officially rolled out Automatic Super Resolution, an upscaling technology competing with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, with new features alongside the release.

claims.statement: Microsoft officially released Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology competing with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X and select Copilot Plus PCs.

sources.quote: Microsoft’s DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode

Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today.
Microsoft's Automatic Super Resolution is now officially out for the ROG Xbox Ally X
Microsoft's upscaling tech for video games is now officially available for select Xbox Ally machines, as well as some other Copilot+ PCs.

claims.statement: Auto SR is gaining new features alongside this official release, after Microsoft began testing it in April.

sources.quote: Auto SR is also getting some new features alongside this official release.
